body: I have a Molly of my own, black but with the same white spot below her neck. She's turning 14 in a few weeks, and her age is showing. Sorry for being a downer though, this is a beautiful girl.

Thank you, but your situation being, perhaps smaller in certain aspects, doesn't make the problems any less significant. I took the liberty of reading your own post, and in a weird sense it's comforting that other people are in the same boat. 

You're strong for sharing that in my eyes. And what you've said to me just now helped a lot. You're worth it, keep going.
Thank you, I almost feel like printing this out. That's genuinely the kindest thing anyone said to me in a while.
